title: Recovery Contact Cooldown
summary: Makes a pending recovery email or phone change visible during its hold, so the real owner can cancel a takeover attempt in time.
description: Shows a pending recovery-contact change: the masked new contact, a countdown to when it applies, that codes still go to the old contact, an urgent state in the last hour, a cancel button and a "this wasn't me" path. Announces the outcome, not the ticking.
catches: A recovery email or phone change that hasn't taken effect yet
Masked old and new contacts so the owner can recognise them
Time left, turning urgent in the final hour
One-tap cancel and a "this wasn't me" path
Says the old contact was notified only when previousNotified is true
limits: Displays the hold; it does not create or enforce it
Pending turns to applied on the client clock unless you pass now/status from the server
Masking is cosmetic; the full values still reach the browser
a11y: Section labelled by its title; countdown is role=timer and is not announced every second
Only the outcome (applied) is announced via a polite sr-only region
After cancel or apply, focus moves to the result message
Urgency shown with text and colour
server: The backend must hold the change, keep the old contact working, notify it, and accept cancellation; this card only surfaces that state.
stops: Helps the owner catch a swapped recovery contact before it takes effect
